statement: theorem const_eq (a : α) : const a = a ::ω const a :=
proof_text:
by
  apply ωSequence.ext; intro n
  cases n <;> rfl
gold_proof:
by
  apply ωSequence.ext; intro n
  cases n <;> rfl

statement: theorem tail_const (a : α) : tail (const a) = const a :=
proof_text:
suffices tail (a ::ω const a) = const a by rwa [← const_eq] at this
  rfl
gold_proof:
suffices tail (a ::ω const a) = const a by rwa [← const_eq] at this
  rfl

statement: theorem map_const (f : α → β) (a : α) : map f (const a) = const (f a) :=
proof_text: rfl
gold_proof: rfl

statement: theorem get_const (n : ℕ) (a : α) : (const a) n = a :=
proof_text: rfl
gold_proof: rfl

statement: theorem drop_const (n : ℕ) (a : α) : drop n (const a) = const a :=
proof_text: ωSequence.ext fun _ => rfl
gold_proof: ωSequence.ext fun _ => rfl

statement: theorem head_iterate (f : α → α) (a : α) : head (iterate f a) = a :=
proof_text: rfl
gold_proof: rfl

statement:
theorem get_iterate (f : α → α) (a : α) (n : ℕ) :
    iterate f a n = f^[n] a :=
proof_text: rfl
gold_proof: rfl

statement:
theorem get_succ_iterate' (n : ℕ) (f : α → α) (a : α) :
    iterate f a (succ n) = f (iterate f a n) :=
proof_text:
by
  rw [get_iterate, succ_eq_add_one, add_comm, Function.iterate_add_apply]
  rfl
gold_proof:
by
  rw [get_iterate, succ_eq_add_one, add_comm, Function.iterate_add_apply]
  rfl

statement: theorem tail_iterate (f : α → α) (a : α) : tail (iterate f a) = iterate f (f a) :=
proof_text:
by
  ext n
  rw [get_tail]
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [get_succ_iterate', ih, get_succ_iterate']
gold_proof:
by
  ext n
  rw [get_tail]
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [get_succ_iterate', ih, get_succ_iterate']

statement: theorem iterate_eq (f : α → α) (a : α) : iterate f a = a ::ω iterate f (f a) :=
proof_text:
by
  rw [← ωSequence.eta (iterate f a)]
  rw [tail_iterate]; rfl
gold_proof:
by
  rw [← ωSequence.eta (iterate f a)]
  rw [tail_iterate]; rfl

statement: theorem get_zero_iterate (f : α → α) (a : α) : (iterate f a) 0 = a :=
proof_text: rfl
gold_proof: rfl

statement:
theorem get_succ_iterate (n : ℕ) (f : α → α) (a : α) :
    iterate f a (succ n) = iterate f (f a) n :=
proof_text:
by
  rw [get_succ n (iterate f a), tail_iterate]
gold_proof:
by
  rw [get_succ n (iterate f a), tail_iterate]

statement: theorem iterate_id (a : α) : iterate id a = const a :=
proof_text:
by
  ext n; simp [get_iterate]
gold_proof:
by
  ext n; simp [get_iterate]

statement: theorem map_iterate (f : α → α) (a : α) : iterate f (f a) = map f (iterate f a) :=
proof_text:
by
  ext n; rw [get_map, ← get_succ_iterate, get_succ_iterate']
gold_proof:
by
  ext n; rw [get_map, ← get_succ_iterate, get_succ_iterate']

statement: theorem nil_append_ωSequence (s : ωSequence α) : appendωSequence [] s = s :=
proof_text: rfl
gold_proof: rfl

statement:
theorem cons_append_ωSequence (a : α) (l : List α) (s : ωSequence α) :
    appendωSequence (a :: l) s = a ::ω appendωSequence l s :=
proof_text: rfl
gold_proof: rfl

statement:
theorem append_append_ωSequence : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List α) (s : ωSequence α),
    l₁ ++ l₂ ++ω s = l₁ ++ω (l₂ ++ω s)
proof_text:
| [], _, _ => rfl
  | List.cons a l₁, l₂, s => by
    rw [List.cons_append, cons_append_ωSequence, cons_append_ωSequence, append_append_ωSequence l₁]
gold_proof:
| [], _, _ => rfl
  | List.cons a l₁, l₂, s => by
    rw [List.cons_append, cons_append_ωSequence, cons_append_ωSequence, append_append_ωSequence l₁]

statement: lemma get_append_left (h : n < x.length) : (x ++ω a) n = x[n] :=
proof_text:
by
  induction x generalizing n with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons b x ih =>
    rcases n with (_ | n)
    · simp
    · simp [ih n (by simpa using h), cons_append_ωSequence]
gold_proof:
by
  induction x generalizing n with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons b x ih =>
    rcases n with (_ | n)
    · simp
    · simp [ih n (by simpa using h), cons_append_ωSequence]

statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
lemma get_append_right : (x ++ω a) (x.length + n) = a n :=
proof_text:
by
  induction x <;> simp [Nat.succ_add, *, cons_append_ωSequence]
gold_proof:
by
  induction x <;> simp [Nat.succ_add, *, cons_append_ωSequence]

statement:
theorem get_append_right' {xl : List α} {xs : ωSequence α} {k : ℕ} (h : xl.length ≤ k) :
    (xl ++ω xs) k = xs (k - xl.length) :=
proof_text:
by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := show ∃ n, k = xl.length + n by use (k - xl.length); omega
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]; apply get_append_right
gold_proof:
by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := show ∃ n, k = xl.length + n by use (k - xl.length); omega
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]; apply get_append_right

statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
lemma get_append_length : (x ++ω a) x.length = a 0 :=
proof_text: get_append_right 0 x a
gold_proof: get_append_right 0 x a

statement: lemma append_right_injective (h : x ++ω a = x ++ω b) : a = b :=
proof_text:
by
  ext n; replace h := congr_arg (fun a ↦ a (x.length + n)) h; simpa using h
gold_proof:
by
  ext n; replace h := congr_arg (fun a ↦ a (x.length + n)) h; simpa using h

statement:
@[simp, scoped grind =]
lemma append_right_inj : x ++ω a = x ++ω b ↔ a = b :=
proof_text: ⟨append_right_injective x a b, by simp +contextual⟩
gold_proof: ⟨append_right_injective x a b, by simp +contextual⟩

statement: lemma append_left_injective (h : x ++ω a = y ++ω b) (hl : x.length = y.length) : x = y :=
proof_text:
by
  apply List.ext_getElem hl
  intros
  rw [← get_append_left, ← get_append_left, h]
gold_proof:
by
  apply List.ext_getElem hl
  intros
  rw [← get_append_left, ← get_append_left, h]

statement:
theorem append_left_right_injective (l1 l2 : List α) (s1 s2 : ωSequence α)
    (h1 : l1 ++ω s1 = l2 ++ω s2) (h2 : l1.length = l2.length) : l1 = l2 ∧ s1 = s2 :=
proof_text:
by
  have h3 := append_left_injective l1 l2 s1 s2 h1 h2
  grind
gold_proof:
by
  have h3 := append_left_injective l1 l2 s1 s2 h1 h2
  grind
